risk.rationale: All suspicious signals for prof.kaya@aegean.edu are explained away by verified critics. F2 (CONFIRMED 0.75) is a single non-interactive mail-sync token (ExchangeSync/15) from Turkcell/TR outside baseline ASN — not an interactive human sign-in, so it does not constitute an account takeover chain. F5 (LIKELY 0.5) PT sign-ins are university VPN (vpn-edge-02) from known device LT-3104, consistent with baseline. Impossible-travel, password-spray, and VPN-KEV exposure claims are all rejected with sound critics (shared egress/background noise, patched firmware, vpn-edge-01 unused by this account). No confirmed takeover chain; evidence is sufficient and reconciled. Decision: benign, citing F2 and F5.
